focus.why: node-2 early interface opacification and arrested visual recovery may indicate subclinical infection; node-3 opaque mass, graft detachment, and pseudohypopyon strongly support an infectious process; node-4 progressive worsening supports ongoing infection.

focus.label: Donor-derived epithelial cyst is the cause of graft detachment and pseudohypopyon
focus.why: Histology directly identifies a cyst containing cellular debris with positive cytokeratin and male donor origin, indicating a donor-derived epithelial origin. Confidence is 0.7 because microbiological proof is absent and the progressive clinical course could still be compatible with an infectious process.
